reviews.comment: Dr. GS is AMAZING! Lectures are so interesting & engaging. She gives clear guidelines about what she expects for projects and HW. Book is not necessary if you pay attention and take lots of notes in class. Two untimed, written exams, one partner presentation at the end, & some other assignments; none too hard if you've taken class notes. TAKE HER!!

Not the easiest class, but Dr. GS makes up for it. She does very interesting lectures and makes assignments that are up to date and make the course concepts easier to understand. I got a B since I did not complete a couple of assignments, but if you do well on the final project and engage in the lectures, you should get the A with no problem.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Jessica is one of the nicest profs I have ever had. She makes an effort to learn everyone's name and makes the classroom a super fun environment. She can be kinda tough on grading speeches but she always gives extremely clear feedback on why you got your grade. An A should be pretty achievable with a bit of work and a B is super easy to get.

She is an amazing professor! She cares about her students and learns everyone's name. She is a tough grader on the speeches but is very helpful and open to questions. The rest of the work for her class is fairly easy to complete and as long as you follow the rubric, you should get high grades.

Dr. GS is a sweetheart who gives engaging and currently relevant lectures. Exams short answer and online but she grades them very critically and wants to make sure you know what you're talking about. Other than that, this class was an interesting breeze!

Dr. GS is cool and comes off chill but don't be fooled, she is a tough grader. If you're a good public speaker this class will be a breeze for you. You can definitely procrastinate and get a solid B but you won't get the A unless you work for it.

Totally recommend Dr. GS! Her lectures are very interesting and easy to follow. She makes an effort to learn her students' names and get to know them, which I thought was super cool! She authentically wants you to enjoy her class! Her class does take some work, but if you try, it isn't hard to get an A.

In-class assignments, occasional homework, 2 fully written exams, and 1 group project at the end of the semester will make up the entirety of your grade. The class doesn't require a lot of hours to be put into it, BUT for the stuff you do, she is a hard grader. She is extremely caring and helpful, BUT she wants to make sure you know her stuff!

PLEASE TAKE HER CLASS!! She is honestly the best professor! I enjoyed this class so much. There are two exams and one group project. As long as you attend class and take notes you will do just fine on your exams. Exams are open notes. Her lectures are super interesting. She is understanding and relatable. She cares about her students! TAKE HER! :)
